claim_boundary: This zero-integration fixed-density discriminator tests whether upstream PySCF ISWIG materially reduces the finite-grid rigid-rotation sensitivity of the existing PySCF SWIG control for methanol and acetone. It does not test an ML-SCF root, total SMD hydration free energy, analytic forces, torsion smoothness, active-set continuity under arbitrary geometry changes, QM fidelity, or production readiness.

decision_rule.fail: Failing any locked gate rejects ISWIG as the selected next Route-2 provider candidate without threshold, grid, radius, orientation, or molecule retuning.
decision_rule.pass: Passing every locked gate authorizes only one separately pre-registered analytic-gradient and active-set displacement canary. It does not authorize production integration.

rotation.rotation_center: arithmetic mean of Cartesian atom positions

scientific_risk: ISWIG changes the switching function but retains atom-centred laboratory-frame Lebedev grids and PySCF's weight-times-switch pruning. A fail is therefore expected to remain possible and must be recorded rather than tuned away.
